preferences: Melodic or sung vocals want a sparse, melodic beat in a matching key; dark, busy, chromatic bass beats (e.g. GLOCK over SWARM) sound too busy
Pairings can be any two songs from any genres; it does not have to be an EDM mix
Get to the vocal fast: no long beat-only intro; the vocal should come in within about 4 bars (about 10 seconds)
